$note.combatFeatChancePct: Percent chance a won fight offers a feat, independently of its combat card.
$note.classFeatChancePct: Percent chance each class-track level offers a feat in addition to its class-tree upgrade.
$note.classCardChancePct: Percent chance each class-track level offers a combat card from the class pool, independently of its feat.

$note.{kind}.{end}: The {band} of the cinders that {pool} pays.

$note.{kind}.{rarity}: How often {pool} offers {a rarity} card, weighed against the other rarities in its row. Classes with a table of their own use that instead.

$note.{classId}.{kind}.{rarity}: The {className}'s own reward odds: how often {pool} offers {a rarity} card, weighed against the other rarities in its row.

$note.maxPicks: How many element spells (classless spell attacks of the listed rarities) an affinity class may take among its starting spells at character creation.

$note.offerWeightMult: How many times likelier an affinity-element card is to be picked, within its rarity, in this class's card rewards.

$note.{kind}: Whether winning {pool} offers a card to choose. Off, that fight lays out no card row.
The percent chance that winning {pool} offers its card row. At 100 nothing is rolled; a miss says "No card this time."

$note.onLevelUp: When a fight raises the character level, show a Level Up! button beside the XP bar to choose a bonus card at that fight's rarity odds.
$note.onLevelUpMaxPerFight: How many level card rows one fight can add, however many levels it gained.

$note.cardChoices: How many cards a reward door lays out to choose from.
$note.bossRelicChoices: How many boss relics a boss victory lays out to pick one from (1 or 0: a single relic).
$note.flaskDropBasePct: The chance a fight drops a flask charge, before the run's running adjustment.
$note.flaskDropStepPct: How far that chance falls after a drop, and rises after a miss.
